final: WITH group_avgs AS (SELECT pc.product_type_description, AVG(CAST(ili.product_quantity AS REAL)) AS avg_units, AVG(ili.derived_product_cost - ili.derived_total_cost) AS diff_avg FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS ili JOIN Products AS p ON ili.product_id = p.product_id JOIN Product_Categories AS pc ON CAST(pc.production_type_code AS TEXT) = CAST(p.production_type_code AS TEXT) GROUP BY pc.product_type_description), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(diff_avg) AS avg_diff FROM group_avgs), kept AS (SELECT g.avg_units, g.diff_avg FROM group_avgs AS g JOIN overall_avg AS o ON g.diff_avg > o.avg_diff) SELECT AVG(avg_units), AVG(diff_avg), AVG(diff_avg - (SELECT avg_diff FROM overall_avg)) FROM kept
